newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen gaining on strong sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen gaining on strong sentiment.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected gain when trading reopens on Wednesday, following a government decision to allow price movements in a wider range, brokers said on Tuesday.

"A strong sentiment propelled by easing of the circuit breaker (price barrier), effective today, is expected to push prices of most shares up," said Golam Sarwar of brokers Mahbub Morshed and Company.

The DSE and the Securities and Exchange Commission decided on Monday to allow share prices to move in either direction within a range of up to 10 percent of the previous day's rates, compared to five percent earlier.
The DSE all-share index closed 38.67 points or 1.71 percent up at 2,300.14 on a turnover of 27.8 million taka on Monday. The bourse was closed on Tuesday.
